regimeSub: Hammack/Barkin gradual hike rhetoric + Friday NFP setup drives VIX to 28 as SPX sells off 4.4% from highs.
themes: Fed's Hammack and Barkin Nov 5 signal gradual rate hikes ahead per Reuters/CNBC → 2Y falls 3bp to 4.58% but Dec hike pricing intact with policy rate at 4%
SPX crashes 4.4% to 7353 from 7689 as VIX spikes to 28.18 → risk-off rotation accelerates ahead of Oct NFP per Barron's 'green light for hike' framing
Brent surges 3.9% to $98.29 as OPEC+ quota reset looms per Crux Investor; gold +1% to $4113 on election/Fed uncertainty → haven bid intensifies
Samsung/SK Hynix tumble per CNBC AI selloff contagion → KOSPI down to 5087 as KRW weakens to 1358; Japan bonds rally on risk-off per Bloomberg

signalNotes.note: Real rate at +90bp (4.58% 2Y - 3.7% trailing inflation); restrictive but tightening path priced per Hammack/Barkin guidance

signalNotes.name: 2s10s Curve
signalNotes.note: Steepens to +32bp as 10Y falls 5bp to 4.90%; bull steepening on risk-off rotation ahead of Friday payrolls

signalNotes.note: Spreads widening implied by VIX spike to 28.18 and 4.4% SPX selloff; credit stress building into NFP

signalNotes.note: Explodes to 28.18 from 16.61 yesterday (+69%) → election + NFP + Fed hike path uncertainty compounding

signalNotes.name: Brent Crude
signalNotes.note: Rebounds 3.9% to $98.29 as OPEC+ quota reset speculation resurfaces per Crux Investor; Iran premium creeping back

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: Climbs to $4113.5 (+1%) on haven demand; election uncertainty + hawkish Fed combo driving safe asset bid

signalNotes.name: USD / KRW
signalNotes.note: KRW weakens to 1358 from 1342 as KOSPI selloff accelerates; Samsung/SK Hynix chip rout per CNBC contagion

signalNotes.name: Semiconductor SOX
signalNotes.note: Korea chip names crushed per ChinaTalk $1T crash coverage; AI capex narrative under pressure from rate hike fears

headline: VIX spikes 69% to 28 as Hammack/Barkin gradual hike rhetoric collides with Friday NFP setup, triggering 4.4% SPX selloff and broad risk-off rotation into gold and bonds.
